title: Deepening Emotional Safety
learningGoal: Strengthen emotional safety through consistent, predictable caregiver responses.
microLesson: Emotional safety grows when children know how adults will respond. Predictability reduces fear and supports healing.
activity: List three predictable responses you can commit to this week.

title: Helping Children Recover From Stress
learningGoal: Support children in recovering from stress and overwhelm.
microLesson: Children need co-regulation, reassurance, and calm presence to recover from stress. Small moments of connection matter.
activity: Complete a 5‑minute co‑regulation exercise and reflect on the outcome.

title: Repairing After Difficult Moments
learningGoal: Learn how to repair connection after conflict or emotional rupture.
microLesson: Repair involves acknowledging feelings, offering reassurance, and reconnecting with warmth and presence.
activity: Use the repair script to complete a short repair conversation.

title: Building Consistent Parenting Habits
learningGoal: Develop consistent parenting habits that support stability.
microLesson: Consistency helps children feel safe. Small, repeated actions build trust and reduce behavioural challenges.
activity: Identify one parenting habit to strengthen this week.

title: Supporting Children’s Emotional Growth
learningGoal: Help children build emotional literacy and resilience.
microLesson: Children learn emotional skills through modelling, naming feelings, and practicing coping strategies.
activity: Complete an emotion‑naming activity with your child.

title: Managing Caregiver Fatigue
learningGoal: Recognise and manage caregiver fatigue to support family stability.
microLesson: Fatigue affects patience, consistency, and emotional availability. Managing it protects both caregiver and child wellbeing.
activity: Write a short plan for managing fatigue this week.

title: Weekly Reflection and Stability Check
learningGoal: Reflect on progress and identify areas needing support.
microLesson: Reflection helps track emotional safety, routines, and parenting confidence.
activity: Write a 150‑word reflection on improvements and challenges.
